item.title: Fugitive Hiding Under Child’s Bed Arrested By US Marshals
item.description: The U.S. Marshals Service (USMS) arrested a fugitive who was trying to hide underneath a child's bed Friday, according to a Saturday press release from the agency.

item.title: Guatemala Declares Siege After Gangsters Seize Prisons, Take Hostages
item.description: Guatemalan authorities declared a state of siege Sunday in response to three coordinated prison-gang uprisings and the related killing of nine local police officers, according to multiple outlets.

item.title: Democrats Take Over State, Immediately Move To Soften Crime Laws
item.description: The Virginia state House's Courts of Justice Committee is weighing soft-on-crime legislation after Democrats won a trifecta in the state's government.

item.title: JAMES CARTER And JACOB CHOE: MAGA Isn’t De-Globalization. It’s The Only Globalization Strategy That Still Works
item.description: For years, critics have lazily described Donald Trump’s “Make America Great Again” agenda as de-globalization — a retreat from the world, a rejection of trade, an inward turn. That charge is not merely wrong. It is intellectually dishonest.

item.title: Hoosiers Finish Perfect Season With Historic Title Win
item.description: The victory capped an undefeated season under head coach Curt Cignetti and delivered a thriller that swung back and forth until the final minute.

item.title: Denmark Sends Troops to Greenland as Arctic Tensions Rise
item.description: The deployment comes as global attention has once again turned northward, with Greenland increasingly viewed as a key prize in great-power competition.

item.title: Audio Emerges Casting Doubt on Accusations Against Actor Timothy Busfield
item.description: In the audio, both children deny that the actor ever touched them inappropriately during questioning by investigators.

item.title: SCOT MUSSI: Move Over, Tim Walz. Katie Hobbs Now Most Scandal-Plagued Governor On Ballot In 2026
item.description: Over the past month, Minnesota has been hard at work to set the gold standard for jaw-dropping fraud scandals under the watch of Democratic Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz. The Somali daycare scandal has turned the state into a national punchline — hundreds of millions in taxpayer dollars stolen in plain sight while Kamala Harris’ favorite “masculine” governor looked the other way.

item.title: Ex-IRS Agent and Brazilian Au Pair’s Affair Exposed as Selfies Surface in Wife’s Murder Trial
item.description: The images, introduced in court last week, show the pair embracing, posing with firearms, and openly professing their love while Banfield was still married.

item.title: Men Shout Affair Claims at Kyrsten Sinema Panel as Ex-Bodyguard’s Wife Alleges Romance
item.description: “I’m happy to call her my lover … My wife is leaving me because of you. She’s taking the kids."
